integrated_multimodal_description:
This is a standard vertical 9:16 portrait video. The sky must be at the very top of the frame, the ground and crowds at the very bottom. The frame is NOT rotated — the horizon stays perfectly level and horizontal, gravity points straight down, and the camera is held upright, never tilted sideways. Absolutely forbidden: horizontal composition, any 90-degree rotation of the frame, sideways or tilted ground, a tilted horizon, the sky appearing at the side of the frame, or vertical pillars rendered lying horizontally. [Shot 1] Chinese celestial palace, ethereal xianxia realm in the heavenly court, vast architecture dwarfing tiny human figures, when the shot centers on a figure: medium or close shot of a fictional xianxia character in flowing robes, colossal architecture and mist still towering behind, three-tier spatial layers: foreground columns/archways framing, middle sea of clouds, background grand palace silhouette at horizon, strict central-axis symmetry, one-point perspective vanishing to infinity, at least one floating structure (sky bridge, cloud terrace, floating island), cold blue-gray low-saturation environment, moon white and ice blue tones, high-saturation warm accents only on character costumes (vermilion, emerald, gold), diffused soft light with ethereal mist, no harsh shadows, descending sacred light beams, subtle rim light on flowing robes, deep blue night sky with cold moonlight, misty atmospheric depth. The scene opens on a suspended stone causeway extending into a misty vanishing point, framed by a weathered dragon column on the left edge. A figure (S1) in flowing vermilion robes stands at the railing, their fabric rippling in a soft wind. The camera executes a slow push-in with small amplitude at slow speed, moving from a medium-wide view to a medium close-up of the figure's upper body. From 0 to 3.61 seconds, ten spectral carriages emerge from the swirling cloud sea, seven light carriages glowing with cyan spiritual flames aligning in the upper lane. From 3.61 to 7.23 seconds, four heavy carriages carrying translucent crystal boxes pass in the lower lane; two of these are unoccupied, their front runes glowing and steering autonomously along light trails. From 7.23 to 10.84 seconds, the stream of vehicles converges toward a distant grand palace complex, and the figure raises a hand, causing one carriage to hover beside them as they look back at the flowing traffic. The visuals play as off-screen voiceover narration while lips remain completely closed. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

overall_soundscape:
A serene and majestic ambient soundscape featuring the low, resonant hum of spiritual energy and the soft, rhythmic whoosh of wind pushing through the cloud sea. The sound of ethereal carriages gliding over stone is subtle and crisp, accompanied by a faint, high-pitched chime when the autonomous runes activate. The atmosphere is thick with a cold, misty reverb, creating a sense of vast, silent depth and celestial grandeur.
